twoFactor.enablePasswordStep: Enter your password to start. Signing in with a password will then also ask for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.enableScanStep: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.enableCodesStep: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app, and they are not shown again.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualEntry: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
twoFactor.disableDescription: Signing in will only need your password, and devices you chose to trust will ask again if you turn it back on. Enter your password to confirm.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your current backup codes will stop working. Enter your password to get new ones.
